name: Processor D
justification: Archived Phase 1 measurements reported that Processor B sometimes used fewer two-qubit gates and lower depth than Processor A, although other preliminary runs showed equal depth and CX counts and zero explicit SWAPs. This four-qubit diamond directly supports a linear H2 entangling chain, adds alternate routes without full connectivity, keeps maximum degree three, and preserves a distance-two pair for the Bell experiment. The extra edge may reduce routing exposure, while fewer couplers than a complete graph limits connectivity and calibration complexity; fresh official benchmarks are still required.
